tools.name: treasury_yield_curve
tools.description: Today's (or any date's) US Treasury par yield curve: 1-month to 30-year yields including the 10-year and 2-year, the change from the previous business day and from a month earlier, and the 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads with an inversion flag. Any date back to 1990.

tools.name: treasury_yield_history
tools.description: History of one Treasury yield (e.g. 10y, 2y, 3m, 30y) between two dates: start, end, change, high, low and average, with a daily or sampled table. Up to 731 days per call, back to 1990.

tools.name: treasury_bill_rates
tools.description: Daily US Treasury bill rates for 4, 6, 8, 13, 17, 26 and 52 week bills: the bank discount rate and the coupon-equivalent yield (comparable to a savings or CD rate), with the change from the previous business day.

tools.name: treasury_real_yields
tools.description: US Treasury real yield curve (TIPS) for 5, 7, 10, 20 and 30 years, the nominal yield for the same maturity, and the breakeven inflation rate the market implies (nominal minus real).
